$comment: Canonical local development identity actors. Single source of truth for the one-shot dev seed password and the three password-backed usernames every dev/smoke script may log in with. The seed is a separate development executable and is absent from the production identity-api image. Consumers: tools/dev/local-actors.mjs, tools/dev/local-actors.ps1, infra/docker/compose.dev-bootstrap.yml.
$workforceProvidersComment: Field agents and captains are NOT bootstrap actors. Workforce owns provider actor creation and always provisions Identity with a server-generated workforce code as the username, so a pre-seeded actor holding the same phone can never be adopted. They are provisioned at runtime by tools/dev/local-workforce-provisioning.mjs, which writes the generated actor ids to .artifacts/local-dev/workforce-actors.json. They authenticate by redeeming an activation code, not by password.
